subtitle.zh: 梅瓶小口丰肩，原为酒器，入宋后转为陈设。一瓶一花，是宋人书斋的第一清供。
subtitle.en: The meiping's small mouth and broad shoulders once served wine; by the Song it became display furniture — a single plum branch is the first pure ornament of a scholar's studio.

subtitle.zh: 耀州窑斗笠碗以刻花取胜，刀法在一毫米的胎壁上起伏，所谓入窑一色、出窑万彩。
subtitle.en: Yaozhou conical bowls win by carved decoration, the chisel rippling across a wall one millimetre thick — in the kiln one colour, out of the kiln ten thousand hues.

subtitle.zh: 焚香、点茶、挂画、插花，宋人四般闲事。宣和炉仿自青铜，铜素无纹，以造型本身为纹。
subtitle.en: Burning incense, whisking tea, hanging paintings, arranging flowers — the four elegant idles of Song life. This censer copies bronze, its plain copper surface letting silhouette itself be the ornament.
